study type: secondary analysis of a prospective multicenter observational study
exposure: induction of labor vs planned cesarean delivery
induction of labor for breech presentation
cohort: Women with singleton breech deliveries after 37 weeks gestation (n=4138), excluding those with spontaneous onset of labor, scarred uterus or intrauterine fetal death
finding: Induction of labor for breech presentation does not appear to increase neonatal mortality or severe neonatal morbidity compared with planned cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Two-thirds (67.4%) of the women in the induction of labor group delivered vaginally.
